_comment: evidence 171: realism v2 with the motor block off (thermal needs motor, so thermal is off too)

motor.spec_file_note: the 'modules' entries are converted by realism.survey_module_spec: kt = kt_out/ratio, gear_efficiency 1 (kt_out is measured at the output, internal gear loss included), j_rotor = j_out/ratio^2, i_peak = tau_peak/kt_out (DC-equivalent current reproducing the published peak torque), r_phase = r_line (line-to-line). Back-EMF uses the same kt: no-load speed V/kt_out is 20.3 rad/s for RS03 (datasheet 20.4) and 44.0 rad/s for RS06 (datasheet 50.3, i.e. 12 % conservative).
motor.assign_note: link_efficiency 0.9 = LINK_ETA of run_env/motor_selection_calc for a belt or linkage stage; ankle_pitch is coupled to the knee in arch8 (no motor), ankle_roll is locked in arch8: null keeps the env's own limits

motor.spec_override_note: 2026-10-29: thermal values fitted to the RobStride manual overload tables (evidence 167). They hold for the vendor test mount (aluminium heat-sink plate; the fitted c_th_h of 700-1150 J/K includes the plate); the robot mount is unknown, so thermal.dr widens r_th_ha up and c_th_h down. Previous estimates (maxon-ratio back-calculation, rated -> 125 C) heated 2-5x too fast against the same table: RS03 30 N·m reached 145 C in 72 s vs 393 s.

thermal.loss_factor_note: ESTIMATE: kt_out is per A rms of phase current and r_line is line-to-line; for a star winding the copper loss 3 I^2 R_phase = 1.5 I^2 r_line
thermal.dr_note: ESTIMATE: nominal = vendor heat-sink plate (fit, evidence 167); the robot's leg mount is unknown, so housing-ambient resistance up to 2x and housing capacity down to 0.2x (about the bare motor, c_th_h 148 J/K of the previous maxon-derived value) are drawn

friction.robstride_note: joint side, N·m and N·m·s/rad. Viscous from the manual no-load current (RS03 0.6 Arms x 2.36 N·m/Arms = 1.42 N·m at 200 rpm; RS06 0.98 Arms x 1.09 = 1.07 N·m at 480 rpm; both +-10 %, RobStride/Product_Information@384cc56): b_out = (no-load drag - coulomb_out) / no-load speed = 0.053 (RS03), 0.015 (RS06). Coulomb at the actuator output 0.3 N·m stays an ESTIMATE (no vendor value; K-Scale K-Bot MJCF uses frictionloss 0.2 for robstride_03, kscalelabs/kbot-joystick@211f9a2, also not identified). Through an external stage both scale: hip_roll belt 1.5 (coulomb x1.5, viscous x2.25), knee four-bar rms ratio 1.35 (x1.35, x1.82). ankle_pitch/ankle_roll keep the default (no motor in arch8).
